name: Amol
reviewOutcome: National Iranian cadastral/registration services were identified, but no locally evidenced public parcel geometry service or anonymous safe vector response was qualified.
custodianAssessment: The candidate national custodian is Iran's Registration Organization of Deeds and Properties (SSAA), with cadastre.ssaa.ir and shamim.ssaa.ir associated with cadastral/positioning workflows. A directory/map result references the Amol registration office, but this is not sufficient first-party local registry evidence.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Persian discovery queries were run. They found SSAA, Cadastre, Shamim, My.SSAA, and a local Amol registration-office reference, but no public Amol parcel layer or documented anonymous vector API.
requestOutcomes: Attempted ordinary HTTPS GET to https://ssaa.ir: timeout/no response within 20 seconds.
Attempted ordinary HTTPS GET to https://cadastre.ssaa.ir: bounded request did not return a usable response.
Attempted ordinary HTTPS GET to https://shamim.ssaa.ir: bounded request did not return a usable response.
Attempted ordinary HTTPS GET to https://my.ssaa.ir: bounded request did not return a usable response.
Attempted ordinary HTTPS GET to https://amol.ir: bounded request did not return a usable response.
Direct official-host opens through the research fetcher also timed out for SSAA, Cadastre, Shamim, and My.SSAA.
No JavaScript/configuration, schema/CRS declaration, bounded ID+geometry response, WMS feature response, or safe parcel endpoint was obtained.

geometryEvidence.reason: No unchanged native parcel geometry response was received.

scopeLimits: A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, or timeout is not evidence of citywide absence.
National service existence does not establish Amol coverage, administrative-boundary alignment, or public anonymous access.
The local-office directory result is not treated as first-party cadastral geometry evidence.
No source integration, adapter qualification, or runtime admission is claimed.
uncertainty: Moderate for existence of Iran's national cadastral custodian and related services; high for anonymous public parcel geometry, stable native identity behavior, Amol citywide coverage, and runtime integration readiness.
recommendedDisposition: Hold for serial reviewer retry with first-party access and independent confirmation of a public, safe ID+geometry route.
